notes.title: Ditzy Demons Released + Announcements!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/cbcae651070130940573fd31913c4a945f440c13.png[/img]
[h1]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me is now available on Steam!![/h1] 
Our friends at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Denpasoft]Denpasoft[/url] are handling the 18+ DLC so make sure you're following them on Steam! You can also read a tester blog from Kevin R. for the 18+ ver over on the 
[url=https://denpasoft.com/blogs/news/ditzy-demons-tester-blog-1]Denpasoft blog![/url] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/70c73830b6ccd96e1932fd9cebd0826653e1891e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802870/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me/]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
Ren’s virginity is in danger as he is suddenly pushed into the school’s special girl's dormitory full of useless demons. Assigned as an assistant to watch over them, his happy and troublesome days as a teacher for these cute but incompetent demons has begun.
[h1]DLC[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/948430/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me__18_Adult_Only_Content/]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me - 18+ Adult Only Content[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962820/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me__OpeningEnding_Theme_Songs/]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me - Opening/Ending Theme Songs[/url]
[h1]Bundles[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8900/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me_Adult_Limited_Edition/]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me Adult Limited Edition[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8899/The_Ditzy_Demons_Are_in_Love_With_Me_Adult_Edition/]The Ditzy Demons Are in Love With Me Adult Edition[/url]
*Please note that the DLC is supposed to be on sale and We're talking to Valve to update those sale prices as soon as possible!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/07bedc018f2434ee2aad053280e739f4a9436606.jpg[/img]
Mark your calendars for Nov. 9th! Last Stanza will be heading to Steam on that day! There is a demo available for you to try on the Steam page. 
[h1]Key Features[/h1]
Linear route, visual novel
A short but impactful story written in almost 70,000 words
Story brought to life with 12 unique characters, beautiful backgrounds and a wonderful soundtrack.
Available in English and Portuguese - Brazil languages 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/9e1948feae416687d940c72fa0a95d5b6fe62e7e.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/835130/Last_Stanza/]Last Stanza[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
Last Stanza is a slice of life, dramatic visual novel that deals with the consequences of a tragic event from different perspectives.
December, 2009. On a day in the last week of that month, I realized how slowly dripping tears had a shivering yet uneasy feeling. The coming of winter turned the air thin and cold. The clouds blocked out the sunlight that normally reached the ground making it seem as if the sun was absent.

Many days passed and life seemed to return to normal as if nothing had happened. To conceal my anger and confusion and slowly regain control of my thoughts, I opened my heart up to friends old and new to try at any cost to find a new place for myself.

But it is in peaceful moments such as these when even a single seemingly inconsequential action can set up a chain reaction like the endless waves of a once calm ocean turned violent, bringing to the shores of my mind the emotions I had thought were long locked away.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/72a8c8d6663c8b583fb917c5a50187b79158a6c6.jpg[/img]
We also have another exciting game to share with you! You can check out the exclusive look at National Park Girls from Studio Coattails over on [url=https://www.ricedigital.co.uk/exclusive-studio-coattails-next-project-is-national-park-girls/]Rice Digital![/url] You can find more details about projects from Studio Coattails over on their [url=https://twitter.com/StudioCoattails]Twitter.[/url]

[h1]Story[/h1]
All Eve ever wanted was to protect and preserve the land, but after five years of being a ranger in Yosemite National Park, she’s just about ready to throw in the towel. The people are careless, her co-workers are annoying, and thanks to an increasingly tight budget she can hardly do her job. Fed up and burned out, Eve lashes out, but after being transferred to a remote cabin post in return, she only finds herself more uncertain of the value of being a ranger. Soon after arriving, three strange girls corner her in the cabin. Not only do they claim to live there, but they also say they’re the manifestations of Zion, Yellowstone, and Yosemite National Parks! Are these girls really who they say they are? Why is Yosemite so obsessed with her research? And why does one of them have a volcano on their head? Follow Eve as she gets closer with these spritely cuties that put the “natural” in “supernatural,” and maybe even discovers a new kind of love for the parks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/0802b41756780a97cfda8c707447d74b02261f8c.png[/img]
Our other announcement is that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Denpasoft]Denpasoft[/url] recently released Seven days with the Ghost on Steam! This is an occult yuri game created by members of 2ch, Seven days with the Ghost takes place at the girls-only Keisei Academy, in the modern era where magic exists alongside science.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/d6d538ed06b795933f378c26237a13a18c574835.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/946460/Seven_days_with_the_Ghost/]Seven days with the Ghost[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
Ayako is the only member of the Occult Research Club at girls-only Keisei Academy. Needing to attract more students or have her club shut down, she tries to seek out the "Seven Wonders of the Academy". What she finds is more than she bargained for. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/7c4cebd8ea989106b2de43a103cf824d9a3f52dd.png[/img]
And finally our last announcement is that Nanairo Reincarnation will be coming soon to Steam! We're still working on getting the Steam page up, so please look forward to this fantastic title coming soon~

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/7951d44211c6c2a07cfe7b711656c4f19e0903af.png[/img]
[h1] Innocent Forest: The Bird of Light and Innocent Forest 2: The Bed in the Sky are now available on Steam! If you have a VR headset and enjoy visual novels we highly recommend you check it out![/h1] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/a0d06bde9f580866cef2b0ce17a1d6b4be698c60.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929170/Innocent_Forest_The_Bird_of_Light/]Innocent Forest: The Bird of Light[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
“When you step into this forest, you lose one memory…”
Innocent Forest is fantasy story about a girl called Luclei and the memories of her visitors.
The forest of lost memories: a place where they say you can forget one painful occurrence.
Kei, a young man lost in the forest, encounters a mysterious girl named Luclei who lives among the woods and gathers a flock of birds. 
It is through these birds the past, present and future of lost memories unfolds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/12a9f624422f32152d2c58071acff3c70592989c.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929180/Innocent_Forest_2_The_Bed_in_the_Sky/]Innocent Forest 2: The Bed in the Sky[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
The forest of lost memories: A doctor named Hauser, just moved into the town. While he takes a walk in the town, he steps into the forest and then meets a girl, Luclei, in the sudden washing rain. Luclei catches a cold by walking in the rain. Hauser has been afraid of facing a patient from his memory of a girl he couldn’t save, but he regains his lost memory with the girl as he nurses Luclei... 
This Time, series second edition published. Second edition's Title is "The Bed in the Sky".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/29048d6e8fea043ce3ae7005acf9429cb7570d48.png[/img]
Our friends at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Denpasoft]Denpasoft[/url] also just released a bunch of 18+ DLC on Steam! To view their content make sure you have adult only sexual content checked off in your steam preferences!
[h1]18+ DLC are available for these titles:[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33429918-Ne-no-Kami/]Ne no Kami Series[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/NEKO-NIN]NEKO-NIN exHeart Series[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/KARAKARA]KARAKARA Series[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/891510/Loves_Sweet_Garnish/]Love's Sweet Garnish[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/349841937ecd9d3be0552da0b084efe6ecb232b3.jpg[/img]
[h1]A More Beautiful World is now available in early access on Steam![/h1] You can view the update plans in their latest Steam announcement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/436680/announcements/detail/1680297062345839748]here.[/url] You can follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/afterthoughtstudios]Afterthought Studios developer page[/url] to find out all the updates on their titles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3202207/52f9b16b600149e0ab94f369bb4d899ed5a2e142.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/436680/A_More_Beautiful_World__A_Kinetic_Visual_Novel/]A More Beautiful World[/url]
[h1]Story[/h1]
Magic vanished when the ancient wizards who ruled Gallantia were ousted by the armies of man. Knowledge of the arcane and the ones who worked the ancient Blessings were lost - buried in the sands of time. Magic has been relegated to the realm of myth, of superstition.

We highly recommend following our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/sekaiproject]Sekai Project publisher page[/url] to stay up to date with all our releases and information! As always, thanks for your support and checking out our updates!

[h1]Story[/h1]
What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! 

Kashou Minaduki, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie. 

But upon moving out, hidden amongst his things were two of the catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, that the family had been raising. When he tried to send them back, they begged and pleaded until he gave in and now they've opened La Soleil together. 

With two catgirls who really, REALLY love their master trying their very best and occasionally failing -- a heartful comedy opens for business!

notes.title: NekoPara Trading Figure Box
notes.content:
At long last figures of the catgirls from the NekoPara series are here! Under the supervision of creator, Sayori, her SD illustrations of Chocola, Vanilla, Azuki, Coconut, Maple, Cinnamon, Shigure and Milk are brought to life in these cute figures. Each box contains a full set of all 8 figures.

[Preorder Bonus] Each box will also include an original illustration shikishi hand-signed by Sayori!

Release Date: December 2016

Preorder Cutoff: August 31, 2016

http://preorder.sekaiproject.com/

notes.title: NEKO WORKs coming to Anime Expo!
notes.content:
We are honored to announce that we are bringing a few of our close friends and developing partners as our guests to this year's Anime Expo in Los Angeles: 

From Japan, the face of NEKO WORKs, leading the drafting, artwork, and release of everyone’s favorite catgirl comedy series, NEKOPARA: Sayori! 

From CreSpirit, the Taiwan-based development studio behind the wildly popular 2D exploration platformer, Rabi-Ribi: CEO and president, Sirluma, translator, Ian Lee, and artist, Saiste! 

From the Japanese doujin circle, ALICE IN DISONANCE, creators of the fault series: founder, writer and director, Munisix, and art director, Hare Konatsu! 

In anticipation of Anime Expo, Sekai Project is also launching a special giveaway campaign on social media. Starting the week of May 23rd, every Friday leading up to AX on July 1, Sekai Project will select the best or most interesting social media post from Facebook, Twitter, Tumblr, or Instagram that uses the hashtag “#NEKOPROJECTAX.” Winners will receive NEKOPARA-themed prizes! 

Stay tuned for more information on this campaign that will be posted soon on our [url=https://sekaiproject.com/blog/]blog[/url] and social media pages.

notes.title: NEKOPARA Vol.1 Launch/New Years Giveaway
notes.content:
Is everyone enjoying the holidays so far?

Probably by now you've spent all your money, either on presents or the Steam sale, and some of you want to buy NEKOPARA when it launches today at 6pm (PST) but can't dig out enough change from your couch to make up $10. Don't worry, we're here to help! We don't want to know what it's like to spend the new year without having catgirls by our side, and we don't want you guys and gals to suffer that fate.

If you want to earn a free copy check out this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/sekaiproject#announcements/detail/206369795189850826]announcement[/url]!
